notes.title: May 18, 2024
notes.content:
1. Smoother camera
2. Better melee
3. Fixed the pitch of the jump sound
4. Minor changes to levels

notes.title: Walk, Stats and more localizations!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]You can now walk while pulling the arrow! The difference like between Resident Evil 5 and 6
[*]The inventory menu now shows character stats and makes it easier to understand what upgrades equipment provides
[*]Added French, Polish and Korean localization
[*]Removed a couple of very annoying enemies
[/list]
